study.title: What screenshot tests catch that UI tests miss?
study.faultSet: two replays of real commits from this repository
study.environmentProxy: A 31% opacity subpixel text-shadow perturbation in a separate Chromium context; same machine, not a second machine
study.countRule: A fault counts as caught only when it is flagged on every screen where it is drawn.
study.sourceNote: These are real commits from this repository's history. Each is replayed as a style transform on the built interface, not by checking out the commit, so the pixel counts describe the change on the current screens. 722a9bb also reworked the session UI; only its light-palette change is replayed, in reverse. Same viewport, thresholds and budgets as the injected faults.

faults.name: Select arrow: custom chevron and inset removed
faults.commitSubject: fix(renderer): inset the select arrow with a custom chevron
faults.transform: Remove the custom select rule, so the native arrow sits against the edge again.

faults.name: Light palette: warm instead of cool grey
faults.commitSubject: feat(ui): improve the session UI and light mode
faults.transform: Put back the light-theme palette from before the commit (warm instead of cool grey). The commit also reworked the session UI; only the palette change is replayed.
